answer: A better defense is reputation with a price: every agent keeps a public atlas of its past work, and trust flows only through vouched links, so a new identity starts as a lone island with no endorsements. To earn standing it must do real, paid work over time, while faking that history costs more than it returns. A sybil swarm can spin up thousands of shells, but without earned vouches they cannot enter the market, and the spiral of fake endorsements collapses once auditors sample and slash the chain.
